nodes.description: Public constant bytes32 role identifier that gates the mint() function via AccessControl.
Public constant bytes32 role identifier that gates pause() and unpause().
Private mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) storing role members and admin roles in AccessControl.
Private mapping(address => uint256) of token balances in ERC20.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of spend allowances in ERC20.
Private uint256 tracking total token supply, mutated by _mint and _burn.
Private bool emergency-stop flag in Pausable controlling token transfers.
Public constant bytes32 (0x00) that is the admin of itself and default admin of all roles.
Public function that mints new tokens; requires MINTER_ROLE and calls internal _mint.
Public function that halts all token transfers; requires PAUSER_ROLE.
Public function that resumes token transfers; requires PAUSER_ROLE.
Internal hook executed before every transfer/mint/burn; enforces the not-paused check.
Internal ERC20 function that increases _totalSupply and recipient balance using SafeMath.add.
Public function destroying the caller's own tokens via _burn.
Public function destroying tokens from another account using the caller's allowance.
Internal function decrementing balance and _totalSupply via SafeMath.sub.
Internal function moving balances with SafeMath.add/sub and emitting Transfer.
Public allowance-based transfer entry point that updates the spender allowance.
Internal function writing _allowances and emitting Approval.
Public role-granting function; requires the caller to hold the role's admin role.
Public role-revoking function; requires the caller to hold the role's admin role.
Public self role-renunciation function; caller must equal the account argument.
Public view access-control predicate checking membership in _roles.
Internal unchecked role grant used only during construction/initialization.
Private function that adds a member to a role and emits RoleGranted.
Private function that removes a member from a role and emits RoleRevoked.
Context helper returning msg.sender; used as the authority source for role checks.
Address library function performing an unbounded-gas call{value:} to an arbitrary recipient.
External caller address; controls role-gated mint/pause/unpause and token movement.
recipient.call{value: amount}('') low-level value transfer that hands control to an arbitrary address before state is finalized.
Parameter 'to' of mint(); destination of newly created tokens.
Parameter 'amount' of mint(); quantity of tokens to create.
Parameter 'role' of grantRole(); role identifier to grant.
Parameter 'account' of grantRole(); recipient of the granted role.
Local bytes32 holding extcodehash(account) in Address.isContract.
Parameter 'recipient' (payable address) of sendValue(); callee of the low-level call.
Local bool capturing the success flag of the low-level value call.
Address library view function returning true if the account has deployed code.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by _msgSender and thereby flows into every authorization decision.
The caller identity returned by _msgSender() is used inside mint()'s role check.
msg.sender is compared against stored role membership through hasRole in all role-gated functions.
mint() reverts unless hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, caller) is true, gating privileged supply creation.
mint() forwards the validated call to the internal _mint routine.
Caller-supplied 'to' parameter is consumed by mint().
Caller-supplied 'amount' parameter is consumed by mint().
'to' flows into _mint where the balance mapping is credited.
'amount' flows into _mint where total supply and balance arithmetic occur.
_mint writes _balances[account] using SafeMath.add, the arithmetic state mutation for supply issuance.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath.add, a supply-integrity arithmetic operation.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
pause() requires hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, caller) before halting transfers.
pause() writes the privileged emergency-stop flag _paused.
unpause() requires hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, caller) before resuming transfers.
unpause() clears the privileged emergency-stop flag _paused.
grantRole() checks hasRole(adminRole, caller) before granting any role.
grantRole() delegates the privileged mutation to _grantRole after the admin check.
revokeRole() checks hasRole(adminRole, caller) before revoking any role.
revokeRole() delegates the privileged mutation to _revokeRole after the admin check.
renounceRole() requires account == _msgSender(), i.e. comparison against msg.sender, to prevent privilege removal of others.
_setupRole() calls _grantRole without any authorization check, an unchecked privileged path if misused outside construction.
_grantRole() writes membership into the _roles mapping that governs all permissions.
_revokeRole() mutates the _roles mapping that governs all permissions.
hasRole() reads role membership directly from _roles, the authorization state.
burn() destroys the caller's tokens through _burn.
burn() derives the account to debit from the untrusted msg.sender.
burnFrom() destroys tokens from a third party via _burn.
burnFrom() rewrites the spender allowance through _approve before burning.
transferFrom() performs the balance movement through _transfer.
transferFrom() decrements the spender allowance through _approve.
_transfer mutates _balances of sender and recipient using SafeMath.add/sub.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping consumed by transferFrom and burnFrom.
sendValue() executes an unbounded-gas value call, transferring control to an arbitrary address.
The caller-controlled 'recipient' parameter is the direct target of the low-level value call.
The success flag of the external call is checked by a require after control returns, the classic post-call state assumption.
The callee can re-enter sendValue's caller while the value transfer is still in flight, enabling reentrancy.
isContract() assigns extcodehash(account) to the local codehash used for its return value.

normalization_plan.reason: 'to' is a mint()-scoped parameter with no independent state; it is fully absorbed by the mint function node.
'amount' is a mint()-scoped parameter that only influences _mint arithmetic; it collapses into the mint function node.
'role' is a grantRole()-scoped parameter consumed by the auth check; it collapses into the grantRole function node.
'account' is a grantRole()-scoped parameter consumed by the auth check; it collapses into the grantRole function node.
codehash is a temporary local inside isContract and carries no cross-function semantics.
'recipient' is the sendValue()-scoped callee parameter and is represented by the sendValue function node.
success is the return flag of the low-level value transfer and folds into the unsafe_operation node it validates.
